info.name: Mamo Business Business Details Recipients API
info.description:
Mamo Business API follows the REST model. Its purpose is to enable Mamo Business users to automate payment link generation, charges, subscriptions, disbursements, recipients, cards, expenses and webhooks. Accepts JSON request bodies and returns JSON responses.

Contact Support:
 Name: Mamo API Support
 Email: api@mamopay.com
